verdict.rationale: The Gemini API video docs show Veo is reachable programmatically: prompts and images can be turned into videos and refined over turns via the Interactions API. That covers roughly the 'submit the prompt' step. The same docs urge migration to other models to avoid service interruptions. Agent-readable machine docs are weak: ai.google.dev llms.txt and every probed OpenAPI path returned 404, and the DeepMind llms.txt covers only prompt formatting. missing for 10: documented job/operation polling to watch generation status, documented asset retrieval/download, any API-level cost or usage reporting, machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI/llms.txt) for the API docs, hands-on evidence of an agent completing the loop from docs alone.
